recreation_notes.text: barra_l1 Test 02 steps 01-25 pulse public solenoids 1-25 one at a time; Test 03 names held switches 1-48 and nothing for 49-64; buttons 84 and 82 are copied into 34 and 35 and fabricate 47/48 and 45/46. Gameplay shows the five switch-fired specials, the start sequence, bank resets, the eject-hole lock, 3-ball Multi-Ball, the outhole kick and the ball roll tilt. No run establishes bulb quantity, physical location or mechanical timing.

init.note: The drawing set's Power Turn-On page describes the Diagnostic Mode as credits 04, ball in play 00 and the game identification in the player 1 display; one power-up from empty CMOS stops there. This run writes the NVRAM every later run starts from.

play.limitation: The host writes every ball-presence switch itself (ramp positions, shooter lane, eject holes, outhole); those writes are stimulus, not ROM evidence, and a wait that ends on an output censors how long that output would have stayed on. Lamp numbers are public addresses only.

play.note: Coin switch 4 fires the bell 15 three times. Start fires game-on 25, both bank releases 9 and 10, the eight single-target resets 1-8 in order and the ball ramp thrower 12. The upper eject hole gate 17 energizes 5.13 s after the shooter switch 16 opens and drops 0.03 s after the thrower serves the next ball for an upper eject hole lock. An out-of-sequence RR target fires only its own reset 3; a completed B-A-RR bank fires 3, 2, 1 and a completed A-C-O-R-A bank 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, each raising its targets one by one with no bank release. Switches 20, 21, 22, 29 and 30 fire 18, 19, 20, 21 and 22 within 20 ms. Top lane 17 lit lane lamp 17; the right button moved it to 18; the left button changed nothing with no lamp of 20-22 lit. A ball in the lit upper eject hole fires the thrower 0.18 s later; in the lit lower eject hole 3.09 s later. 5.14 s after the third plunge the gate energizes and the upper eject hole kicks, and the lower eject hole kicks when the upper hole switch opens. An outhole closure fires the ball release 11; the ball roll tilt drops game-on 25 0.04 s after the closure.

sol.note: Each Advance in Manual-Down shows the next step number in the ball-in-play display and transitions that public solenoid alone; step 25 wraps to 01. Step 16 pulses the coin lockout from its energized game-over rest and leaves it off; step 25 pulses game-on 25 off from its energized rest, which is the booklet's 'Flipper relay is de-energized with subtest 25'. Steps 23 and 24 are pulsed although Table 4 fits no load there. Test 01 (lamps) drove 64 lamp addresses, 1-64.

sw.limitation: The booklet says Test 03 shows a switch number only momentarily; readings are taken from held snapshots. A blank reading for 49-64 agrees with the matrix's NOT USED cells but is not itself proof that no contact is fitted.
